title: Identity-Aware Recurrent Toxicity Classifier
summary: The solution lowercases and regex-tokenizes comment text, builds a 120,000-token vocabulary from training comments only, maps unknown tokens to a dedicated ID, and head-truncates sequences to 220 tokens. A learned 300-dimensional embedding with spatial dropout feeds a bidirectional LSTM followed by a bidirectional GRU. Max and masked mean pooling are taken from both recurrent outputs, concatenated, and passed through a residual ReLU/dropout dense block to produce one toxicity logit and one logit per identity label. Training uses length-bucketed shuffled batches, AdamW, mixed-precision gradient scaling, gradient clipping, and epoch-wise multiplicative learning-rate decay. The main BCE-with-logits loss is mean-normalized and upweights identity-mentioned examples plus toxicity/identity mismatch groups; auxiliary identity BCE is added. Inference sorts by length, dynamically trims padding, and applies sigmoid to toxicity logits. Validation predictions from the final two epochs are averaged.
